profile_text.body:
Sierra is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2023 that builds conversational AI for businesses. According to its own site, Sierra helps companies create customer experiences that the company describes as "better, more human," with an emphasis on combining automation with interactions that still feel personal and thoughtful. A customer quoted on the site, Sarah Wallis, characterizes the goal as delivering a better and faster experience without sacrificing that quality.

The company's primary product, tracked under the enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration category, is an AI platform aimed at improving customer experience through conversational agents. Sierra's held facts indicate a notable legal exposure footprint, with 181 cases recorded in California, though no specific litigation details are available in the current data.
